visualCharacteristics.purpose: Short closing banner with a pale-washed background photo and dark centered eyebrow, H2, CTA and note
visualCharacteristics.description: Short banner, not full height; photo washed out by a pale overlay with dark centered text (eyebrow, H2 rather than H1, button, small note). Reusable for the destinations template closing CTA (section.amalfi-cta-section).

contentPattern.structure: row 1 (optional): background image; row 2: eyebrow paragraph (optional), H2, CTA link, note paragraph (optional)
contentPattern.description: Background photo with overlaid eyebrow, H2, CTA and note: a hero (photo background belongs to the block).

usage.description: Closing call-to-action section on the homepage and destinations template (amalfi-cta-section).

reuseGuidance: Use for end-of-page CTAs over a washed-out photo with dark text. Not for the top hero (use hero-overlay).

cells: Eyebrow paragraph (optional), Title heading (H1 for top hero, H2 for closing), subheading paragraph, CTA link (buttons have no href in source; use link), optional note paragraph
